bibliographic.title: Winfrey Hollow
bibliographic.author: Nikora Studio
bibliographic.language: English, Russian, Castilian, German (en, ru, es, de)
bibliographic.description:
Winfrey Hollow is an 18+ browser-based narrative sandbox focused on exploration, nonlinear quests, character relationships and player choice.

Explore a changing town, meet its residents and follow different storylines at your own pace. The game features layered character visuals, wardrobe and inventory systems, character conditions, finances, collections, minigames, and an in-game phone and journal.

Winfrey Hollow is built with Twine and SugarCube 2 and is playable online in English, Russian, Spanish and German. No download, installation or account is required for the public version.

The project is currently in active development. All characters participating in sexual content are adults.
